messages.author: Zornik
messages.content_text:
He who has a why, can bear almost any how.

I started watching my first trading videos in December 2025. By the summer, I had graduated and began applying for engineering jobs, but I couldn’t land a single one. Everywhere I went, I heard the same thing: “You don’t have any experience.”

That’s when it really hit me, five years of my life spent on something I don’t even enjoy.

Right now, I’m working a job I hate, but I need it to have some income.

Four months later, I’ve blown two accounts due to revenge trading and using way too much leverage. Hence why I’m now committing to the following rules:


Two trades a day, if it’s a W close laptop, if its a L I can risk again with less risk (75 first trade 50 second trade). Second lose, close laptop and tape read pa after the gym. If its BE you can look for re entry if DOL is still intact. BE is also a trade.
,


Risk 12.5% of max drawdown per trade, as I’m not super confident in myself, I want to give myself 8 trades before blowing.
,


Journal all trades in this channel, even non trading days.
,


Journal your emotions everyday, also after the trades.
,


Chase this dream like there is no tomorrow nigga.
,

apr 22 Notes:


Today I did not take any trades and the reason was that price action was rangey and the other reason was I would usually be very bullish, but today there was no trading below 18:00 at all so that stayed in the back of my head.
,
The only trade that I would really consider is after 10:00 because we had smt’s at the lows and a 5in rb that we were rejecting out of and then so many stacked highs at ath. We retraced and tapped a 5min ob and made a real manipulation move under 10:00. The problem with this trade is that there were so many stacked lows below and since we instantly traded higher I thought that might have been manipulation to go lower. This is genuinely a 10:00 setup I look for though, trying to find a pd array right below it if there isn’t enough manipulation. Just not a favourable day for me personally and a day that I like to skip.
,
